title: EulerRadians
description: An XYZ Euler rotation in canonical RADIANS. Deliberately a separate contract from vec3.schema.json, whose components are canonical METERS: reusing the meters vector for an angle would make the schema state a unit it does not mean, and Spec 002 Requirement 7 makes one canonical unit per quantity a contract rule rather than a convention. Radians are canonical because Blender's rotation_euler is radians, so there is zero conversion at the Blender boundary; degrees are a language-edge unit converted exactly once in packages/spatial. JSON cannot encode NaN/Infinity, so the finite rule is additionally enforced by the validation layer.
